messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to formalize a "spillover handshake" between Admission and QuotaBank. Observed problem: tenant bursts -> soft credits get dropped, router oscillates and SRE sees noisy throttles. Proposed behavior: explicit two-way handshake that returns either a LEASE or a REDIRECT+hint so routing and metrics are deterministic.

alex: Isn't that just moving the problem around? what's the practical win here? :thinking_face:

maria: It reduces ambiguity in decision paths. Router can act deterministically based on the reply instead of guessing fallback behavior. Also yields clearer telemetry (lease_granted vs redirect) and makes rollout safer.

jordan: Tradeoff: extra RPC hop means extra p50/p95. Any measurements?

sam: We can make handshake opt-in. Default stays optimistic (no extra hop). Handshake only for flagged tenants or high-risk pools.

maria: API sketch (POC):
```
POST /v1/lease/request
{ tenant_id, tokens_requested, prefer_lease: bool }
-> { status: "LEASE" | "REDIRECT", lease_id?: string, redirect_pool?: string, ttl_seconds?: int }
```
This makes the decision explicit and machine-readable.

rahul: How do we prevent amplification attacks where clients issue many tiny requests to get lots of small leases?

maria: Mitigations: enforce min_lease_size (e.g., 8k tokens) and per-tenant lease-rate cap. Also require abuse_score < X for automatic lease; otherwise always REDIRECT or probabalistic admission.

alex: Ops/metrics we should add: lease_requests_total, lease_denied_by_abuse, redirect_rate_by_tenant, avg_lease_ttl. Rollout plan: enable flag for Dedicated -> private customers first.

infra-bot: Added checklist item: "spillover-handshake deploy runbook" https://internal/checklists/spillover-handshake

sam: Another big concern: cache miss penalty if we redirect to a different compute pool. We need cache-version compatibility or the redirect will cost lots of cold-KV lookups.

maria: Agreed — require redirect_pool to encode model variant and cache_version header. e.g., redirect_pool: "p4-v2/cache-v1" and router must propagate KV headers.

jordan: Could we instead return a small hint (e.g., RSVP snippet) that lets edge do local best-effort re-batching instead of full redirect?

maria: That's an idea: offer both types of response. status: REDIRECT or HINT. HINT = "try local burst pool first". HINT avoids cross-pool cold-cache but still signals to throttle logic.

alex: Implementation note: keep handshake RPC synchronous and lightweight; avoid touching heavy DBs. QuotaBank should use in-memory fast caches and soft-fail to previous behavior if overloaded.

maria: Action items:
- I will draft a 2-pager RFC with sequence diag + API details (EOD)
- alex + sam: prototype router changes (opt-in flag)
- rahul: abuse thresholds proposal
- infra-bot: add rollout checklist link to RFC

maria: Can we sync 30m tomorrow 09:30 to align on rollout and metrics?
jordan: +1
sam: +1 :+1:
